posts.text:
Every time I look at the calendar, they keep adding more days

I keep thinking I'm getting towards the end of it but nope; yet again, there's a month

Idk what I'm missing
I guess the people shooting at Trump are just carrying out self defense assassination attempts
Machine wash on highest heat possible with contrasting colors. Tumble dry very high for 3 hours
I have all but stopped using the accounts and haven't found myself wanting to get back on them. not much there thats worth being there for anyway
Our army stands ready, catselves will steeled by the gay agenda

I should just delete that account tbh. Threads is meta cancer and engagement only happens on random bullshit. They still heavily suppress anything with a link to the point of it being useless to post links in the first place
Sometimes I forget about my stuff cross posting to Threads and wowee are the replies there as wild as ever

I personally think it would be rad as hell if our military service members fought our enemies by throwing their pronouns at them

Might work better than starting the dumbest war since the last one
Anyway, love this for you, @ohheyitsgina.bsky.social
Every package gets a ride-along dedicated Notification Guy to provide detailed vignettes to better prepare you to emotionally connect with your parcel when it arrives

I ordered something from a place that is just way too eager with the shipping updates

It’s like;

SUBJECT: "Your package is on the way!"

Hello, Endeavorance! 

We are writing to inform you that we signed in to our DHL account!
Do y'all think the poop deli has drinks too?
Once I figure out how to unlock fast travel it's over for you bitches

The number of people citing “i only still use it for porn” when it’s been multiple years and also *this is the internet, it’s mostly porn* is wild

I get it, artists had audiences. They’ve had multiple years of time to migrate and they haven’t 

skill issue (the skill is not tacitly accepting nazis)

"daddy daddy what did you do when the nazis came back"

"well little timmy. i did nothing. i was too attached to the 'raucous conversation' to even stop going to a single webbed site"

There was a shooting near the White House involving secret service. Shooter reported dead; not a mass shooting

Make no assumptions, believe no random images of tweets, and remember that the answer to our problems will not be found by scrolling further
sorry sir but all the dishes labelled (gf) on the menu are only for girlfriends
